china_race_dynamics.text: I think most people are very unaware. Over 75% of the negative stuff on data centers here in the United States is done by communist China on social media platforms, and the reason they are doing that is they don’t want us to have data centers because they want to lead in AI and data centers and they don’t want us to. So much like they interfere in elections and everything else, China is trying to change the narrative here in America.

deepseek.reason: The speaker describes China’s efforts to undermine US data centers and AI leadership without explicitly endorsing a policy priority of competing with China.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement clearly discusses China competition but does not explicitly call for making it a US policy priority.

astra.reason: The speaker alleges China opposes US data centers to advance its own AI leadership but does not explicitly prioritize US competition with China.
astra.confidence_reason: The competitive framing is explicit, but the speaker does not state a policy priority or endorse a competitive tradeoff.
